title: Emend get_document_state result
description: The result of the Emend-hosted `get_document_state(doc)` MCP tool (TD-1 §3.2), as amended by the TD-1 amendment for #92 (PROPOSED until the owner ratifies it). It is the agent's read path for one document: its raw `content` and `revision`, every tracked change with its current `disposition`, the comments it is offered, every thread's `closure` and linked changes (FR-AGENT-8), and its D21 `protection`. The response is state, not an event stream: it carries no cursor and no history (D35). It confers no authority: no Emend tool accepts, rejects, resolves, dismisses, reopens or unlinks anything (D21). Strict, because these are Emend's own tools: an unknown key is a contract violation. Until the implementing card binds `agent::state`'s result to this schema, the shipped result still carries `pending_changes[]`, `comments[].resolved` and no `threads[]`.

content.description: The document's raw text on disk, CriticMarkup included (TD-6's canonical coordinate space).

revision.description: The content-hash revision token for `content` that `propose_changes` validates against (TD-7).

changes.description: Every change the document's TD-4 record set holds, plus every live marker that joins no record (TD-16 `snap:` identity).

comments.description: The comment threads the agent is offered (TD-21 ruling 9, J10 child-first note). Closure is not stated here; it is stated in `threads[]`.

threads.description: Every thread except those FR-CMT-9 withholds after withdrawal, whatever its closure.

protection.description: Whether the document is in the D21 protected set.

disposition.description: A tracked change's current disposition (FR-AGENT-8). `pending`: its marker is live in `content`. `accepted`/`rejected`: the change's `ChangeRecord.outcome`, which Emend writes only after the saved document decides it, or, for a record with no `outcome` field at all, its thread's linked-change decision. `unknown`: no live marker and no recorded decision, never reported as `pending` (FR-X-5).

anchor.description: Raw-file offset and length of the live marker (TD-6), the coordinate space `propose_changes` ranges use.

id.description: The durable `chg-` id for a recorded change, or a snapshot-scoped `snap:` id for an unrecorded live marker (TD-16).

author.description: The recorded change's author (TD-4). Absent for an unrecorded live marker, which has no record.

anchor.description: Present only while `disposition` is `pending`; a decided change's marker no longer exists.

body.description: Empty for a withdrawn root served only as the context wrapper for a live reply.

closure.description: The thread's current closure outcome, derived once by the comment fold (FR-AGENT-8, FR-CMT-15, FR-CMT-20). `dismissed` appears only once the fold records dismissal (D25).

linked_changes.description: Every tracked change an address round linked to this thread, oldest first (FR-CMT-7).
